author: Verybadsorry
body: So, for a very long time...I was known as the really annoying kid who constantly ban evaded and that was very true, thos was true until about a week ago, when it all clicked. I realised what a dick id been to the staff, how much of an absolute idiot to mods in general. About 7 months ago I spoke ot  jiveh when I was banned for ban evading. HE was explaining ot me how stupid I was being, constantly evading and at the time I just said "oh well whatever". Now, whether you appeal me or not id like to take this to say sorry to EVERYONE I was a dick to. But if you unban me, I promise that I will help make this server improve for the better. Even a time of when I could possibly unbanned would be amazing. Regards, Oscar
